notes: Round-1 scenarios. Input API: emulator.input {buttons:[...]} sets the full held set (release = []). Route steps are executable in analysis/tools/routes.py (ROUTE) and analysis/tools/cover_replay.py; snapshots exported to scratch/snap_<name>.bin (same-build, local, disposable). Tracing: capacity 0, kinds Instruction/ControlFlow/BankSwitch, short traced windows ('t' steps) because tracing runs ~4 fps. Frame counts are emulator frames (emulator.step unit=frame). Redirect r01-a: probe helpers analysis/redirect/r01-a/probe.py (import/poke/trace/dump to scratch/observed-r01a.json); new same-build snapshots scratch/snap_{gothim,dayend_menu,dayend_menu2,results_win,roundinfo_all,roundinfo_r1,hawaii_sea}.bin. Tracing ran ~2.5 fps. | Redirect r02-a review: all milestones S01-S16 visited; natural bite (L-008) deferred, return-to-port menu not reached (no classification value). | Redirect r04-a: read-watch runs from scratch/snap_*.bin via analysis/redirect/r04-a/readwatch.py (scenario step lists inside); no new milestone.

routes.power_on_to_fight: analysis/tools/routes.py ROUTE: reset; 4960f -> title; START(6f)+90f; A(6f)+60f name entry; START(6f)+60f confirm; A(6f)+180f weather; START(6f)+60f cockpit [boat_menu]; A(6f)+260f; A(6f)+260f [harbor]; DOWN 30f; A 60f; DOWN+A 200f [sea]; POKE ram $0496=1; 380f [bite]; A(4f)+380f [fight]
routes.sound_test: reset with SELECT+START held for 60f -> SOUND TEST (debug path $E315 -> $FA27). UP increments $EA, A plays, B/SELECT exits.
routes.land_fish: snap fight; input [a]; 2x(write ram $075D=[0,0,0]; step 1f); release; 120f [gothim]; 6x(A 4f + 90f) -> weigh-in, keep (A=YES), back to sea
routes.day_end: snap sea; write ram $0755=[59,59,15]; 330f [dayend_menu: TIME IS UP]; A 4f + 90f [dayend_menu2: WEIGHING/GO FISHING AGAIN/RESULTS]; DOWN 6f+20f x2; A -> results; A every 120f -> password -> Round_InfoScreen
routes.hawaii: snap dayend_menu2; write ram $079E=[1,1,1,1]; results route; at Round_InfoScreen [roundinfo_all] SELECT 4f + 90f -> HAWAII 1 [roundinfo_r1]; START 4f + 120f cockpit (KAWAIHAE); A 6f+150f x2; DOWN 30f; A 60f; DOWN+A 100f [hawaii_sea], AreaIndex=4
routes.ending: snap dayend_menu2; write ram $079F=[255,255,255], $0777=[0xB0,0x01]; DOWN x2; A [results_win]; then 60f steps with A every 120f: CONGRATULATIONS -> YOU HAVE WON ALL TOURNAMENTS -> password -> FIN screen
routes.fight_event: snap fight; write ram $05C4=[4]; 200f; 4x(A 4f + 60f) -> Fight_EventScript2 $E521 runs script $E5DC (event 4), flag cleared, fight resumes
